dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The fence here seems to be broken...

dialogues.speaker: Xona
dialogues.text: Huh? Ah, of course! That rampaging Tatankasaurus must have smashed into the fence just now...

dialogues.speaker: Xona
dialogues.text: Thanks for bringing it to my attention. Once I've finished forging these, I'll get to fixing it. *sigh* I hope that reckless little fella didn't hurt itself...
